messages:
Oliver Kim: hey everyone — Oliver here, first day on Eng Runtime (he/him). joining from EST. quick questions: 1) who to ping for MDM if the company portal shows no devices? 2) how do I get temp creds to test against the staging model endpoint? 3) whos my onboarding buddy? also fun fact: I collect vintage mechanical keyboards.

Tara (Buddy): welcome Oliver!! :tada: Im Tara, your buddy. Ill DM to set a 30-min sync. For staging creds, ping Jay (IT) and include your team name + intended test window.

Jay (IT): hi Oliver  sent MDM invite at 09:12 and MFA enrol link. If nothing shows, hit https://intranet.redwood/mdm-enroll and then restart the Company Portal. For staging creds, open an access request: https://intranet.redwood/access with "staging-temp" template. Example note: `purpose: perf smoke test, window: 4/21 10:00-14:00 EDT`. We'll attach temporary keys.

Oliver Kim: thanks Jay  I can see the MDM invite now. submitting the access request with that note.

Priya (People Ops): welcome and congrats! :balloon: Welcome kit shipped. If you prefer a 13" macbook or a 14" linux, reply and we can swap. New-hire orientation invite should be in your calendar.

DevexBot: Heads-up: join #eng-runtime, #devex for docs and pairing slots. New-repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/README.md

Tara (Buddy): also adding you to the weekly infra pairing on Thursdays. Ill share a short list of first-tasks (CLA, runbook READMEs, small bug) so you have a quick PR on day 2.

Oliver Kim: awesome, thanks! requested linux 14" and submitted the staging request. happy to dive into a small bug tomorrow — keyboard pics incoming later :keyboard:
